blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Makati City Regional Trial Court (RTC) has issued an extradition warrant of arrest and hold departure order against detained Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) leader Pastor Apollo Carreon Quiboloy and two of his associates, following a formal extradition petition filed on behalf of the United States government. In a statement, the DOJ said the Makati RTC Branch 145 issued the order on Nov. 12 covering Quiboloy, together with KOJC officials Teresita Tolibas Dandan and Helen Panilag. The DOJ said the court issued the arrest order “after finding probable cause that the three individuals are the same persons […]...
